description: Commission of Elections - Elected Mrs. S. S. W. Kongahage as a Member of Central Province Provincial Council
categorisation: This gazette notification concerns the filling of a vacancy in the Central Province Provincial Council due to a resignation. It details the process of nominating a new member (Mrs. S. S. W. Kongahage) by a political party and her subsequent declaration as elected by the Election Commission. The content is specifically about an electoral process for a provincial council, falling squarely under the "Elections Gazettes" category (Type 7).
